title: Human decision and specialist referral UI
scope: Present reviewed clearance, evidence request and specialist referral with rationale and stale-version checks

acceptance.text: Present reviewed clearance, evidence request and specialist referral with rationale and stale-version checks
Verify keyboard confirmation, permission denial and no irreversible action from agent suggestions
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR
Follow docs/DESIGN_STANDARD.md; supply relevant viewport/state screenshots and keyboard/accessibility evidence for human visual review

verification: Verify keyboard confirmation, permission denial and no irreversible action from agent suggestions

evidence.text: Review page /auditor/cases/{id}/review (DecisionPanel and forms): officer clearance (close outcomes need a cited finding), evidence request (requestEvidence) and specialist referral (new refer_to_specialist outcome, needs specialist.refer; Jube escalate). Every action carries the rationale or reason the officer wrote and the case version and Jube status they viewed (expected_version, expected_case_status); stale views, a case moved in Jube, an open decision and expired proposals are refused with an explanation and a reload, keeping the text. Contract: getCaseReview, proposeDecision, reviewDecision added to openapi.json (ADR-018) with 4 examples; contract.py valid (24 examples). Fixture: scripts/fixture_review.py, 13 tests in tests/contracts/test_fixture_review.py.

e2e/review.spec.ts (8 tests, Edge 156): keyboard-only referral (Enter opens the confirmation, Escape sends nothing, Enter on Propose sends exactly one POST); agent suggestion 'Use as a starting point' only fills the form and sends nothing; server-side 403 shown with no retry; specialist not offered evidence requests or referrals; proposer cannot approve, a different supervisor approves; stale view refused (409) with text kept; expired proposal refused; retry after a lost response reuses the Idempotency-Key and records one decision. Unit: DecisionPanel.test.ts (6) and api/review.test.ts (7). Backend: test_engine.py referral permission and viewer actions per role; 243 backend tests pass.

Screenshots in docs/evidence/TAX-042 at 1440/1024/390px (screens) and 1440/390px (confirmation, stale refusal, validation errors, supervisor approve and reject, specialist permissions), Edge 156 via Playwright; README there lists keyboard and accessibility checks. axe WCAG 2 A/AA: no violations on the review page and open dialog. TAX-023 harness: case-review route added to the matrix; no serious axe violations or page-wide horizontal scroll at all three widths (69 passed). Shared components and tokens reused (frappe-ui Dialog, Button, Textarea, Select, Badge, Alert; StatePanel). Not done: 200% zoom check and screen reader pass. Visual approval is for the area owner.

Tests and results recorded under criteria 1, 2 and 4 and in the PR body; status set to IN_REVIEW and review PR #156 opened (cross-review requested from Kananelo or Keletso, contract review from Keletso, decision-rule review from Edga).
